about_the_game:
"Less pretty, more witty. The civilization economics simulator for players who think."

__FORGE YOUR ECONOMIC DYNASTY__

In CivEconomy, you aren't just conquering lands – you're building the economic foundation of a lasting civilization. Guide your kingdom from primitive stone tools to complex financial institutions as you navigate the intricate balance of production, consumption, and trade across the ages.

Begin with humble settlements in the stone age, carefully managing scarce resources and seasonal challenges. Gradually develop technologies, establish trade routes, and build a dynamic economic system that evolves with each decision you make. Will you create a merchant empire, a military powerhouse financed by shrewd taxation, or perhaps a balanced realm where both crown and commoners prosper?

__KEY FEATURES:__

• __Deep Economic Simulation__ – Manage intricate resource chains, market prices, and wealth distribution with realistic economic modeling that reacts to your decisions

• __Multi-Era Progression__ – Advance through five distinct technological paradigms, from primitive tools to rationalized methods, each unlocking new economic possibilities

• __Dynamic Season System__ – Adapt to changing seasonal effects that impact production, consumption, and population growth throughout the year

• __Comprehensive Territory Management__ – Expand across a 50x50 hex map, establishing settlements and exploiting terrain-specific resources

• __Robust Trading Network__ – Dispatch merchant caravans, establish trade routes, and navigate the risks and rewards of commerce with neighboring territories

• __Taxation & Laws__ – Implement sophisticated taxation policies and emergency powers to regulate your economy through prosperity and crisis

• __Population Class System__ – Balance the needs and contributions of various social classes as your civilization grows in complexity

• __Data Visualization__ – Track your economic progress through detailed charts and historical data to make informed strategic decisions

• __Diplomatic Relations__ – Engage with AI civilizations through trade, competition, and complex relationships that evolve over time

• __Military Development__ – Build and maintain armed forces that protect your economic interests and expand your influence

__EVERY DECISION ECHOES THROUGH HISTORY__

From the first stone tools crafted by your people to the bustling markets of your imperial capital, every economic decision shapes your civilization's development. As seasons change and years pass, watch your realm transform through the wealth generated by your economic policies.

With unparalleled depth and historical authenticity, CivEconomy challenges you to think like both a ruler and an economist. Your legacy awaits – will you build an economy that stands the test of time?

---

*CivEconomy is a single-player strategy simulation game developed for players who appreciate deep economic systems, thoughtful civilization building, and historically-inspired gameplay.*

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 or equivalent modern distribution
  • Processor: Dual-core processor (Intel Core i3 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: X11 with compatible window manager
  • Storage: 700 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent (or Apple Silicon with Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
